## Activity

North City Eye Clinic recorded 475 captures during January 2019. Capture activity was maintained throughout the month, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The reported activity provides the basis for review of image quality and grading outcomes for the site.

## Image quality

There were 4 ungradable captures. This represented an ungradable rate of 0.8 per cent. The image-quality result is recorded for the full set of captures submitted during January 2019.

## Grading

A total of 90 results were graded as referable. The median lag from capture to grading was 10 days. These figures summarise the grading position for North City Eye Clinic during January 2019. No operational issue was noted in the session lists other than routine leave.
